T0092.title: Underground Database Operator
T0092.definition: A core underground data-trading actor who controls and operates social-engineering databases, credential-stuffing data, or leaked datasets.
T0092.description:
An underground database operator sits upstream in the data-abuse supply chain, illegally acquiring, consolidating, cleaning, and updating large volumes of sensitive data. Sources may include insiders, intrusions, credential-stuffing results, historical breaches, and bulk purchases from data suppliers.

They monetize the data through query portals, subscriptions, bulk sales, or reseller channels, providing the foundation for targeted fraud, identity misuse, and criminal intelligence services. Controls focus on breach tracing, takedown of database services, abnormal bulk queries, and upstream supplier mapping.

T0092.usageExample: This "Database Operator" holds hundreds of millions of leaked records and never directly engages in fraud. Instead, they act like a wholesaler, splitting and renting out different categories of databases to downstream fraud and trafficking rings.
